bio.text: Scott Hilton represents District 48 in the Georgia House of Representatives.

According to his legislative biography, Hilton is a senior vice president for commercial banking at SouthState Bank and previously served as executive director of the Georgians First Commission in Gov. Brian Kemp's office.
The biography says Hilton served in the Georgia General Assembly from 2016 to 2018, graduated from Georgetown University, and completed an accelerated MBA at Emory University.
It says he lives in Peachtree Corners with his wife and three children.
